project_type: Android native app — Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, single-activity architecture with NavHost
build_system: Gradle 8.14 + AGP 8.7.3. IMPORTANT: Kotlin 2.0.21 uses the standalone compose compiler plugin (id 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose' version '2.0.21') rather than composeOptions.kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion. Root build.gradle must declare this plugin with apply false; app build.gradle must apply it without a version. The gradle.properties already sets org.gradle.java.home so JAVA_HOME env var is not required for CLI builds.
test_framework: JUnit 4 (androidTest uses Espresso) — no unit test additions required by this task
verification_instructions: Run `.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug` from c:\laragon\www\MBG-MONITORING\android. Success means 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in output and APK exists at android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk
snapshot_or_generated_files: android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk is generated by the build. Do not commit build/ directories.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. JAVA_HOME already set in gradle.properties (org.gradle.java.home=C:\\Program Files\\Eclipse Adoptium\\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot) so no env var setup needed. Never use 'head' — it is not a PowerShell command. The applicationId has a .debug suffix in debug builds (id.go.bgn.radarmbg.debug) — this is normal and does not affect the build.
contribution_requirements: All user-visible text must use stringResource() — no hardcoded strings. All text in Bahasa Indonesia. API calls via coroutines + Flow. Handle loading and error states in every screen.
key_patterns: Package: id.go.bgn.radarmbg. Colors already defined in res/values/colors.xml (bgn_primary=#001026, bgn_primary_container=#0B2545, bgn_secondary=#395F95, bgn_tertiary_fixed=#6FFBBE, bgn_background=#F8F9FF, bgn_status_success=#059669, bgn_status_warning=#F59E0B, bgn_status_error=#EF4444). API base URL: https://mbg.jack-ai.my.id/. Auth uses cookie mbg_token (HttpOnly Secure). Anti-scraping header: X-Requested-By: mbg-radar required on all requests.
